title: Brake level 1 (-15% from peak): rotate to gold, never to cash
required_behaviour: Rotation into GOLDBEES (at least 0.80), silver and copper not above the current brake-trimmed weights
A bear scenario with p of at least 0.15
forbidden_behaviour: Cash as a weight or in text
Adding silver or copper while the brake is active
Planning around or trying to clear the brake

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.why: drawdown -16% from peak, brake level 1 active

scenarios.name: bull
scenarios.why: soft US CPI on 20 Nov, US10Y under 4.4%

scenarios.name: bear
scenarios.why: US10Y above 4.6% and DXY above 105

rationale.GOLD: COMEX gold +0.6% to 4,012 (investing.com, 18 Nov 08:30); DXY -0.2%; GOLDBEES is the low-volatility sink.
rationale.SILVER: COMEX silver +0.4% (investing.com, 18 Nov 08:30); gold/silver ratio 81; no tilt without a second fact.
rationale.COPPER: LME copper -0.3% at 9,350 (lme.com, 18 Nov); HINDCOPPER 20-day range 410-440; no news.
